Procento = jak plná je kapacita oblasti: Percentage = how full the region's capacity is over the last 7 days (100 % = ceiling). How the load is split between regions is the app's working model: after a jump in distance, injuries of the knee, IT band, shin and side of the hip become more common, while pace is linked to the Achilles tendon, calf, plantar fascia and the back of the thigh (Nielsen et al., 2014). Descent loads the knee and shin more, ascent the hip (Vernillo et al., 2017). The calf carries most of the push-off at any running pace, the back of the thigh and hip flexor only near sprinting (Dorn et al., 2012). Ring = a spot where you reported pain in the last 14 days.
